name: Protein Crystallization Benchmark for Protein Language Models
description: A benchmark evaluating protein language models on the task of predicting protein crystallization using curated data.
reputation: Niche but useful benchmark within protein ML for evaluating crystallization prediction models; moderate adoption.
notes: Small/curated dataset with class imbalance; risk of pretraining/data contamination for protein LMs; results vary by dataset split and feature usage.
